related.title: Apache Parquet：column pruning 與 row-group statistics
related.titleEn: Apache Parquet: column pruning and row-group statistics
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：手工建立含 NULL 的 int32 欄，區分值緩衝與 validity bitmap。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Build an int32 column with NULLs and distinguish value buffers from validity bitmaps. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 同時用投影欄位與 min/max 篩掉不需要的 row group，計算可讀取的資料量。
related.differenceEn: Use projection and min/max predicates to prune columns and row groups and compute candidate bytes.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: NULL 的實際值槽內容不能當有效值；bit 表示 validity，切片另有 offset，alignment 可能增加配置大小。 教學基準：10*4 = 40 value-buffer bytes；第二檢核：ceil(10/8) = 2 validity bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Parquet 以 row group 中各 column chunk 組織；統計可排除確定不匹配群，但候選仍須檢查。 教學基準：4*5*10 = 200 unpruned MiB；第二檢核：1*2*10 = 20 candidate MiB after two prunings。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The stored payload of a NULL slot is not a valid value; validity bits,offsets and allocation alignment are separate. Teaching baseline: 10*4 = 40 value-buffer bytes; second check: ceil(10/8) = 2 validity bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Parquet organizes column chunks within row groups; statistics can exclude impossible groups while candidates still require filtering. Teaching baseline: 4*5*10 = 200 unpruned MiB; second check: 1*2*10 = 20 candidate MiB after two prunings. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: HTML 表單：原生驗證與提交狀態
related.titleEn: HTML forms: native validation and submission state
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：手工建立含 NULL 的 int32 欄，區分值緩衝與 validity bitmap。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Build an int32 column with NULLs and distinguish value buffers from validity bitmaps. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 列出name、type、disabled、checked、required、value與validity；以requestSubmit路徑觀察互動式驗證。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate name, type, disabled, checked, required, value and validity; observe interactive validation through requestSubmit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: NULL 的實際值槽內容不能當有效值；bit 表示 validity，切片另有 offset，alignment 可能增加配置大小。 教學基準：10*4 = 40 value-buffer bytes；第二檢核：ceil(10/8) = 2 validity bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

表單有效性、成功控制項與伺服器驗證是三個不同邊界；disabled 控制項不應被當成送出的值。
教學基準：8-2-1 = 5 controls；對照：5-1 = 4 controls。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The stored payload of a NULL slot is not a valid value; validity bits,offsets and allocation alignment are separate. Teaching baseline: 10*4 = 40 value-buffer bytes; second check: ceil(10/8) = 2 validity bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Constraint validity, successful controls and server validation are different boundaries; disabled controls must not be mistaken for submitted values.
Teaching baseline: 8-2-1 = 5 controls; comparison: 5-1 = 4 controls.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
